author_or_account: UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
title: Young voices shaping a safer online world
discussion_signal: The department presents youth participation as an input into online-safety policy covering AI, technology, and life online, while audience reactions endorse including young people and ask whether consultation will shape product roadmaps rather than remain a policy exercise. This supports a governance reading in which safety and platform design are contested through voice, trust, and implementation.
linked_research_question: Do young people experience online-safety governance as protection, participation, surveillance, or a reason to leave platforms?
limits: No demographic or response-rate information for the LinkedIn audience
The post does not establish whether consultation changes platform practice
